T0541.title: Cloud IAM
T0541.definition: Cloud identity and access management controls for users, roles, service accounts, policies, and permissions.
T0541.description: Cloud IAM defines access boundaries for cloud resources, service accounts, roles, and policies. Overbroad permissions, leaked long-lived keys, incorrect cross-account trust, or service-account abuse can lead to cloud compromise. Controls focus on least privilege, temporary credentials, conditional access, permission review, and alerts for high-risk operations.
T0541.usageExample: Assess Cloud IAM related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
